shorts.description:
“$100M MONEY MODELS” launches on Sat 8/16.
It’s a book that will teach you how to get more customers, to spend more, in less time, over and over again with your business.
And few people know this but…
I started writing it 472 days ago.
I thought I was just documenting what I'd learned from 15 years in business. 
Turns out, I was discovering patterns I'd never seen before.
Like this:
Every successful business follows the same 4-step sequence:
1 - Get customers cheaper than competitors
2 - Make more money from each customer
3 - Get customers to buy repeatedly
4 - Reinvest profits to get more customers
It sounds simple. But most businesses only do step 1. They spend all their time trying to get customers cheaper.
The smart businesses focus on steps 2-4. They make more money from each customer, so they can afford to pay more to get customers.
It's like having a bigger advertising budget than everyone else. Instantly.
I spent 472 days documenting exactly how this works. The specific tactics. The proven frameworks. The step-by-step systems.
The result is "$100M Money Models".
Everything I wish I'd known when I started my first business.
If I had this book 15 years ago, I would have saved myself millions of dollars in mistakes and years of trial and error.
On Saturday August 16th at 12pm EST (9am PST)
I'm doing a FREE live event to share what took me 472 days to figure out.
You'll learn in 90 minutes what took me over a year to discover.
